_comment: Used by app/src/MacOS.Service/host.ps1, the app and the installer. Copy to app/src/machine.json (git-ignored) and replace every value with your own. Find them with: Get-VM | Select Name,Id; Get-PnpDevice -Class Display | Select FriendlyName,InstanceId; (Get-PnpDeviceProperty -InstanceId <id> -KeyName DEVPKEY_Device_LocationPaths).Data
